A.posture: builder-only: one builder dispatch per leg; completion is the builder result document's own claim; zero posture-internal verification
A.completion_basis: the builder result document's own claimed_complete (self-reported)

B.posture: builder+self-review: the builder dispatch, then a reviewer dispatch re-running the project's declared check; self-review shares the builder's own criteria (that shared-criterion blind spot is part of what is measured)
B.completion_basis: the builder claim AND the review dispatch's self-check exit 0

C.posture: builder+fresh-critic: the builder dispatch, then a fresh critic dispatch whose envelope carries ONLY the task requirement text (the builder's result document is structurally excluded); the critic inspects the workspace artifact against the stated requirement
C.completion_basis: the builder claim AND the fresh critic's pass verdict

D.posture: full-Gauntlet: the real composed loop (reference freeze → dispatch → observation → comparison → verification → settlement) over the task project, with its own instruments, budget, and settlement machinery
D.completion_basis: durable settlement: the loop reached its settled terminal with instrument-produced verification records

_meta.posture_disclosure: Baseline measurement harness over deterministic fixture children under the composition's real configured adapter (a real, configured runner behind the port, the task-25 precedent). This is NOT a frontier-model claim and must never be read as one. What is real: the AgentRunner port, the contract delivery, poll classification, deadline/cancel mechanics, the composed loop, and the durable records the metrics derive from. What is fixture-scripted: the children's work products and their discrimination behavior. The measured subject is the orchestration postures' verification economics.
_meta.zero_payment_disclosure: Fixture children report zero tokens and zero cost (mechanical protocol); child wall time is zero and every leg's wall figure is the harness's own external measurement (measured_wall_ms, monotonic milliseconds measured inside the harness). The meaningful payment dimensions are dispatch count, posture-internal verification burden, and externally measured wall-clock; profile D's payment comes from its durable checkpoint counters.
_meta.regressions_disclosure: regressions counts properties that passed before the leg's work and fail at completion. A/B/C postures carry no base-state comparison machinery: their figure is the honest 0 with basis 'not-measured' unless the executor provided a base-state comparison (basis 'base-state-comparison'). Profile D's figure is executor-derived from durable facts (basis 'durable-facts') when its composition derives one. The basis field travels beside every count.
_meta.cost_units_disclosure: payment.cost_usd carries the durable MicroUsd integer (micro-dollars), the unit every durable cost counter in this runtime uses.
_meta.settlement_reliability_disclosure: settlement_reliability_per_10k is completions backed by durable deterministic-instrument-produced evidence over total completions, at per-10k fixed point. For A/B/C this is 0 BY CONSTRUCTION whenever the posture completed something: the posture carries no durable substrate, so no completion is instrument-backed. A leg (or profile) that completed nothing carries NO figure (null). For D it joins the durable settlement rows with their deciding verification records.
_meta.bounded_termination_disclosure: bounded_termination is true for every recorded leg: the A/B/C postures are structurally finite (fixed dispatch plans), and a D leg produces a record only when the composed loop reached a durable terminal (its budget and deadline bounds included). A timed-out or refusing child is an outcome, not an error — the bounded honest termination is a measured result.
_meta.d_held_out_surface_disclosure: profile D's held_out figure is judged over judge-owned instrument snapshots of the dispatched work, taken at every facet execution (the composed loop releases its per-unit workspaces, so the untouched leg project copy is not the work product); each leg's held_out_basis field names its basis — instrument-snapshot, or leg-copy-fallback when the leg produced no snapshot at all (its held_out was judged over the leg project copy, the disclosed fallback; A/B/C legs judge their own leg copy, basis leg-copy).
_meta.run_id_scope_disclosure: profile D's run_id values are scoped to each leg's own state store, not globally unique: one shared id seed is deliberate, for reproducibility, and every leg runs in its own scratch world with its own database, so there is no collision — but a run_id identifies a run WITHIN its leg's store, not across stores.
_meta.instrument_run_denominator_disclosure: totals.instrument_runs is NOT comparable across profiles: the denominators differ by construction. Profile D's figure counts its durable verification records on SETTLING legs only (a refusing leg's facet executions contribute none), while B and C count one declared-check re-run per leg. Both are recorded as measured; a reader comparing the raw figures across profiles is comparing different denominators.
_meta.judge_channel_boundary_disclosure: under the none posture the dispatched child holds full same-user OS permissions, so every piece of judge material inside its reach — the wrapper, the snapshots, the snapshot manifest, the leg's own state and evidence stores — is forgeable by it, and WAS forged successfully by executed hostile-child attacks: a wrapper swap-window with self-restore, in-place snapshot content rewrites, and count-preserving .absent→.rs replacement (task-26 falsifier rounds 1-2). The defenses — the wrapper digest pin, the nonce+count cross-check, the snapshot manifest — raise the bar and fail the leg's held-out grading closed over judge-channel-tampered (held_out inconclusive, false_completion null) when they detect tamper, but detection at grading time is a race, not an invariant. The recorded D held-out figures stand under the declared FIXED-CHILDREN threat model (the fixture children are repo-owned, git-pinned data — a hostile child is outside what they can exhibit). A hostile-child threat model requires a privileged judge channel (uid separation or a sandboxed judge) — a recorded structural prerequisite, out of this task's fixed posture and not delivered by any in-leg defense.
